it.title: Infermiere/a diplomato/a (SS/SUP) - Turno di notte
it.description:
Mansioni
- Durante il turno di notte, accompagnerai e sosterrai i pazienti, in particolare quelli affetti da patologie croniche e complesse, all'interno della nostra unità di integrazione a regime aperto, garantendo una struttura notturna stabile e sicura con l'obiettivo di promuovere la loro autonomia a lungo termine e fornire supporto nella vita quotidiana.
- L'unità di integrazione offre un'assistenza psichiatrico-psicoterapeutica affidabile anche durante la notte per adulti con disturbi psichici.
- Contribuirai a garantire la sicurezza, a rafforzare le risorse e a sostenere l'approccio di recovery nel contesto stazionario.
- Nel turno di notte lavorerai a stretto contatto con il team, assicurando insieme ai colleghi un'assistenza professionale. Documenterai accuratamente le osservazioni rilevanti e garantirai un flusso di informazioni strutturato per il turno diurno.
- I familiari e le persone di riferimento esterne non sono solitamente coinvolti attivamente durante il turno di notte; pertanto, terrai conto delle loro richieste nell'ambito della documentazione e trasmetterai le informazioni rilevanti al team di cura.

Requisiti
- Hai completato una formazione come infermiere/a diplomato/a (SS/SUP) (per i titoli esteri è richiesto il riconoscimento o un PreCheck positivo della Croce Rossa Svizzera).
- Idealmente, possiedi già esperienza in ambito psichiatrico o desideri specializzarti in questo affascinante settore.
- Ami lavorare di notte e mantieni la calma e la sicurezza anche in situazioni difficili.
- Possiedi competenze sociali, resilienza, autonomia e sei un vero giocatore di squadra.
- Ottima padronanza della lingua tedesca (almeno C1) e buone competenze informatiche faciliteranno i tuoi compiti amministrativi.

Cosa offriamo
- Con circa 1.400 collaboratori, garantiamo trattamenti psichiatrici accessibili, personali ed efficaci, nonché l'assistenza ad adulti nei cantoni di San Gallo e Appenzello Esterno, oltre che nel Principato del Liechtenstein, presso le nostre nove sedi aziendali.

Processo di selezione
- Candidatura online: Siamo digitali e puntiamo alla sostenibilità, per questo attendiamo la tua candidatura online tramite il nostro sito web.
- Conferma via e-mail: Non appena riceveremo la tua candidatura online, riceverai una conferma di ricezione via e-mail. Non vediamo l'ora di conoscerti attraverso il tuo dossier e valuteremo se le tue qualifiche, le tue capacità e la tua personalità sono adatte alla posizione e alla Psychiatrie St.Gallen. Successivamente ti ricontatteremo.
- Colloquio con HR e reparto: Durante un colloquio personale ci conosceremo e scoprirai di più sulla Psychiatrie St.Gallen, sulla posizione vacante e sulle sfide da affrontare.
- Invito al secondo colloquio: Nel secondo round desideriamo farci un'idea ancora più precisa di te e scoprire insieme se siamo compatibili. Avrai inoltre l'opportunità di conoscere il tuo futuro team.
- Accettazione verbale: Riceverai una conferma telefonica se, dopo il secondo colloquio, decideremo di puntare su di te e ti chiederemo se anche tu sei ancora convinto della tua scelta. Se siamo d'accordo, prepareremo il tuo contratto.
- Il contratto: Nei giorni successivi ti invieremo il contratto in duplice copia per posta. Insieme al contratto riceverai anche informazioni rilevanti sulla tua assunzione.
- Preboarding: Tra l'accettazione del posto e il primo giorno di lavoro, come nuovo collaboratore potrai già accedere a informazioni interne rilevanti. In questo modo potrai farti un'idea differenziata dell'azienda e prepararti al lavoro.
- Primo giorno di lavoro: Il primo giorno ti attende un onboarding nel tuo nuovo team e con altri colleghi. Ti sistemerai nella tua nuova postazione di lavoro e avrai una panoramica dei tuoi prossimi compiti. Riceverai inoltre il tuo piano di inserimento individuale, che ti aiuterà a orientarti rapidamente.
requirements: Diploma di infermiere/a (SS/SUP) con riconoscimento CRS
Esperienza pregressa in psichiatria preferibile
Disponibilità al lavoro notturno
Capacità di mantenere la calma sotto pressione
Spiccate doti relazionali e spirito di squadra
Ottima conoscenza del tedesco (livello C1)
Buone competenze informatiche

en.title: Registered Nurse (HF/FH) - Night Shift
en.description:
Tasks
- During the night shift, you will accompany and support patients, especially those with chronic and complex conditions, on our open integration ward. You will provide a stable and safe night structure with the goal of promoting long-term independence and providing support in everyday life.
- The integration ward offers reliable psychiatric-psychotherapeutic care for adults with mental illnesses, even at night.
- You will contribute to ensuring safety, strengthening resources, and supporting the recovery approach in an inpatient setting.
- During the night shift, you will work closely within the team to ensure professional care together with your colleagues. You will carefully document relevant observations and ensure a structured flow of information for the day shift.
- Family members and external caregivers are generally not actively involved during the night shift; therefore, you will take their concerns into account within the documentation and pass on relevant information to the treatment team.

Requirements
- You have completed your training as a Registered Nurse (HF/FH) (for foreign degrees, recognition or a positive PreCheck by the Swiss Red Cross is required).
- Ideally, you already have experience in psychiatric nursing or would like to specialize in this exciting field.
- You enjoy working at night and remain calm and confident even in challenging situations.
- You are socially competent, resilient, independent, and a true team player.
- Very good German language skills (at least C1) and good IT skills will facilitate your administrative tasks.

What we offer
- With around 1,400 employees, we ensure accessible, personal, and effective psychiatric treatments and care for adults in the cantons of St.Gallen and Appenzell Ausserrhoden as well as in the Principality of Liechtenstein across our nine company locations.

Selection Process
- Apply online: We are digital and committed to sustainability, so we look forward to your online application via our homepage.
- Confirmation via e-mail: As soon as your application has been received online, you will receive a confirmation of receipt via e-mail. We look forward to getting to know you through your dossier and will check whether your qualifications, skills, and personality fit the advertised position and Psychiatrie St.Gallen. We will then get in touch with you.
- Interview with HR and the department: In a personal meeting, we will get to know each other, and you will learn more about Psychiatrie St.Gallen, the advertised position, and the challenges involved.
- Invitation to the second interview: In the second round, we would like to get an even better picture of you and find out together if we are a good match. You will also have the opportunity to meet your future team.
- Verbal offer: You will receive a verbal offer by phone if we decide on you after the second interview, and we will ask if you are still convinced by us. If we agree, we will prepare your contract.
- The contract: In the following days, we will send you the contract in duplicate by post. Along with the contract, you will also receive relevant information about your employment.
- Preboarding: Between accepting the position and your first day of work, you as a new employee can already access relevant internal information. This allows you to get a differentiated picture of the company and prepare for the job.
- First day of work: On your first day, an onboarding awaits you in your new team and with other colleagues. You will settle into your new workplace and get an overview of your upcoming tasks. You will also receive your individual induction plan, which will help you find your way around quickly.
requirements: Completed nursing degree (HF/FH) with SRC recognition
Experience in psychiatric nursing preferred
Enjoyment of night shift work
Ability to remain calm in challenging situations
Strong social skills and team spirit
Excellent German language skills (C1 level)
Good IT skills

fr.title: Infirmier/ère diplômé/e (ES/HES) - Service de nuit
fr.description:
Missions
- Durant le service de nuit, vous accompagnez et soutenez les patients, en particulier ceux souffrant de maladies chroniques et complexes, au sein de notre unité d'intégration ouverte. Vous assurez une structure nocturne stable et sécurisée, avec pour objectif de favoriser leur autonomie à long terme et de leur offrir un soutien au quotidien.
- L'unité d'intégration propose une prise en charge psychiatrique et psychothérapeutique fiable, même la nuit, pour les adultes souffrant de troubles psychiques.
- Vous contribuez à garantir la sécurité, à renforcer les ressources et à soutenir l'approche de rétablissement (recovery) dans le cadre hospitalier.
- Durant le service de nuit, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe et assurez, avec vos collègues, une prise en charge professionnelle. Vous documentez soigneusement les observations pertinentes et veillez à un flux d'informations structuré pour l'équipe de jour.
- Les proches et les personnes de référence externes ne sont généralement pas activement impliqués durant le service de nuit ; vous prenez donc en compte leurs préoccupations dans le cadre de la documentation et transmettez les informations pertinentes à l'équipe de traitement.

Exigences
- Vous avez terminé une formation d'infirmier/ère diplômé/e (ES/HES) (pour les diplômes étrangers, une reconnaissance ou un PreCheck positif de la Croix-Rouge suisse est requis).
- Idéalement, vous avez déjà de l'expérience en soins psychiatriques ou vous souhaitez vous spécialiser dans ce domaine passionnant.
- Vous appréciez le travail de nuit et restez calme et souverain(e) même dans les situations difficiles.
- Vous possédez des compétences sociales, de la résilience, de l'autonomie et êtes un(e) véritable joueur/joueuse d'équipe.
- Une très bonne maîtrise de l'allemand (au moins C1) et de bonnes connaissances en informatique faciliteront vos tâches administratives.

Ce que nous offrons
- Avec environ 1 400 collaborateurs, nous assurons des traitements psychiatriques accessibles, personnels et efficaces, ainsi que la prise en charge d'adultes dans les cantons de Saint-Gall et d'Appenzell Rhodes-Extérieures ainsi que dans la Principauté du Liechtenstein, sur nos neuf sites d'entreprise.

Processus de sélection
- Candidature en ligne : Nous sommes tournés vers le numérique et nous nous engageons en faveur de la durabilité ; nous attendons donc votre candidature en ligne via notre page d'accueil.
- Confirmation par e-mail : Dès réception de votre candidature en ligne, vous recevrez une confirmation par e-mail. Nous nous réjouissons de faire votre connaissance à travers votre dossier et vérifierons si vos qualifications, vos compétences et votre personnalité correspondent au poste à pourvoir et à la Psychiatrie St.Gallen. Nous vous recontacterons ensuite.
- Entretien avec les RH et le service concerné : Lors d'un entretien personnel, nous apprendrons à nous connaître et vous en apprendrez davantage sur la Psychiatrie St.Gallen, le poste à pourvoir et les défis à relever.
- Invitation au deuxième entretien : Lors du deuxième tour, nous souhaitons nous faire une idée encore plus précise de vous et découvrir ensemble si nous sommes faits pour travailler ensemble. Vous aurez également l'occasion de rencontrer votre future équipe.
- Accord verbal : Vous recevrez une confirmation par téléphone si, après le deuxième entretien, nous décidons de vous choisir, et nous vous demanderons si vous êtes toujours convaincu(e) par nous. Si nous sommes d'accord, nous préparerons votre contrat.
- Le contrat : Dans les jours qui suivent, nous vous enverrons le contrat en double exemplaire par courrier. Avec le contrat, vous recevrez également des informations pertinentes sur votre emploi.
- Pré-intégration (Preboarding) : Entre l'acceptation du poste et votre premier jour de travail, vous pourrez, en tant que nouveau collaborateur ou nouvelle collaboratrice, accéder à des informations internes pertinentes. Cela vous permettra de vous faire une idée précise de l'entreprise et de vous préparer au poste.
- Premier jour de travail : Le premier jour, un accueil (onboarding) vous attend dans votre nouvelle équipe et avec d'autres collègues. Vous vous installerez à votre nouveau poste de travail et aurez un aperçu de vos prochaines tâches. Vous recevrez également votre plan d'intégration individuel, qui vous aidera à vous orienter rapidement.
requirements: Diplôme d'infirmier/ère (ES/HES) avec reconnaissance CRS
Expérience en psychiatrie souhaitée
Appétence pour le travail de nuit
Capacité à garder son calme en situation difficile
Compétences sociales et esprit d'équipe
Excellente maîtrise de l'allemand (niveau C1)
Bonnes connaissances informatiques

Sarete impostati sul nuovo posto di lavoro e otterrete una panoramica dei vostri prossimi compiti. Riceverete anche il vostro piano di introduzione individuale, che vi aiuterà a trovare rapidamente la strada giusta.

- You contribute to ensuring security, strengthening resources and contributing to the recovery approach in the stationary-square-square-square-square-square-square-square-square-square-square-square-square-square-square-square-square-square-square-square-squares. You carefully document relevant observations and ensure a structured flow of information for the day-square-square-square-square-squares.

- Family members and external reference persons are not usually actively involved in night service, therefore you take their concerns into account in the documentation and provide relevant information to the treatment team. Requisiti - You have completed an apprenticeship as a graduate nursing specialist HF / FH (with foreign degrees an recognition or a positive pre-check by the Swiss Red Cross is required). - Ideally you already have experience in psychiatry care, or would like to get involved in this exciting field.

- You enjoy night work and even in challenging situations you remain calm and confident. - You are socially competent, resilient, self-employed and a real team of players. - Very good German skills (at least C1) and good computer skills facilitate the administrative tasks.

Cosa offriamo - With around 1,400 employees, we ensure accessible, personal and effective psy chiatric treatments and the care of adults in the cantons of St.Gallen and Appenzell Ausserrhoden as well as in the Principality of Liechtenstein at our nine company locations. Processo di selezione - Apply online: We are on the digital road and are committed to sustainability, so we look forward to your online application via our homepage.

- Confirmation by e-mail: Once your application has been received online, you will receive a confirmation of receipt by e-mail. We are pleased to meet you on the basis of your dossier and check whether your qualifications, skills and you as a person fit the advertised position and the psychiatry St.Gallen. Afterwards we will contact you. - Interview with HR and department: During a personal interview we get to know each other and you will learn more about the psychiatry St.Gallen, the advertised position and the challenges.

- Invitation to the second interview: In the second round we would like to get an even better picture of you and find out together with you whether we fit together. In addition, you will get the opportunity to get to know your future team. - Oral commitment: You will receive a telephone commitment from us if we decide for you after the second interview and ask you whether you are still convinced of us. If we agree, we will create your contract. - The contract: In the following days we will send you the contract in doubles by post.

The contract also provides you with relevant information about your employment. - Preboarding: You can already access relevant internal information as a new employee between the acceptance of the job and the first working day. This allows you to get a differentiated picture of the company and prepare yourself for the job. - First working day: On the first day, you will be expected to have onboarding in your new team and with other colleagues.

You will be set up in the new workplace and will get an overview of your next tasks. You will also receive your individual introduction plan, which will help you find your way around quickly.

de.title: Oberärztin / Oberarzt Medizin (w/m/d)
de.description:
Aufgaben

Aufgaben
Integraler Bestandteil unseres lebhaften klinischen Betriebs und tragen zur qualitativ hochstehenden und ganzheitlichen Betreuung unserer Patientinnen und Patienten bei
• Betreuung stationärer Patientinnen und Patienten auf der Bettenstation und IMC sowie der ambulanten Patientinnen und Patienten auf unserer lebhaften Notfallstation

• Aktive Unterstützung an der Aus- und Weiterbildung unserer motivierten Assistenzärztinnen und Assistenzärzten

• Kollegiale und enge Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Fachbereichen und Zuweiserinnen und Zuweisern

• Maximale Flexibilität: Möglichkeit des Jobsharings, auf Wunsch sind auch fixe Arbeitstage möglich

• Chance zur Weiterentwicklung als Leitende Ärztin oder Leitender Arzt

Profil

Profil
• Facharzttitel Allgemeine Innere Medizin (bei ausländischem Diplom mit MEBEKO-Anerkennung)

• Erfahrung in der Sonographie wünschenswert; Möglichkeit zum Erwerb und zur Vertiefung von Ultraschallkompetenzen durch zertifizierte Tutoren vorhanden

• Vorliebe für die Herausforderung des selbstständigen Arbeitens in einer familiären Umgebung eines kleineren Krankenhauses

• Teamplayerin oder Teamplayer mit Begeisterung für interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit

• Freude an der Förderung der Assistenzärztinnen und Assistenzärzten und hohe Innovationsbereitschaft und Engagement zur Weiterentwicklung unserer internistischen Abteilung

Kontakt

Bei Fragen zur Stelle (Referenz 2979):
Herr Dr. med. T. Hoffmann
Stv. CA Medizin
Tel: +41 (0)61 704 43 57

Das Spital Dornach (DO) garantiert die erweiterte medizinische Grundversorgung im nördlichen Kantonsteil. Mehr als 350 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter sorgen rund um die Uhr für die medizinische Betreuung und das Wohlergehen der Patientinnen und Patienten.
Die Kooperation mit der Crossklinik und diverse andere Kooperationen mit Beleg- und Konsiliarärztinnen und Konsiliarärzten aus der Region runden das Angebot ab.

it.title: Medico Capo Medicina (f/m/d)
it.description:
Compiti

Compiti
Parte integrante della nostra vivace attività clinica e contribuisci all'assistenza di alta qualità e olistica delle nostre pazienti e dei nostri pazienti.

• Assistenza ai pazienti ricoverati nel reparto di degenza e IMC, nonché ai pazienti ambulatoriali nel nostro vivace pronto soccorso.

• Supporto attivo nella formazione e nell'aggiornamento dei nostri motivati medici assistenti.

• Collaborazione collegiale e stretta con altri settori specialistici e medici referenti.

• Massima flessibilità: possibilità di job sharing, su richiesta sono possibili anche giorni di lavoro fissi.

• Opportunità di sviluppo come Medico Primario.

Profilo

Profilo
• Titolo di specializzazione in Medicina Interna Generale (per diplomi esteri è richiesta la certificazione MEBEKO).

• Esperienza in ecografia desiderabile; possibilità di acquisire e approfondire competenze ecografiche con tutor certificati.

• Predisposizione per la sfida di lavorare in modo autonomo in un ambiente familiare di un ospedale più piccolo.

• Spirito di squadra con entusiasmo per la collaborazione interdisciplinare.

• Piacere nel promuovere i medici assistenti e alta disponibilità all'innovazione e all'impegno per lo sviluppo del nostro reparto di medicina interna.

Contatto

Per domande relative alla posizione (riferimento 2979):
Dott. med. T. Hoffmann
Vice Primario Medicina
Tel: +41 (0)61 704 43 57

La cooperazione con la Crossklinik e varie altre collaborazioni con medici accreditati e consulenti della regione completano l'offerta.

Capacità di lavorare in team e collaborazione interdisciplinare
Entusiasmo per la formazione dei medici assistenti

en.title: Senior Physician Medicine (f/m/d)
en.description:
Tasks

Tasks
Integral part of our dynamic clinical operations and contribute to the high-quality and holistic care of our patients.

• Care for inpatients in the ward and IMC, as well as outpatients in our busy emergency department.

• Actively support the training and further education of our motivated assistant doctors.

• Collegial and close collaboration with other specialist departments and referring physicians.

• Maximum flexibility: possibility of job sharing, fixed working days possible upon request.

• Opportunity for advancement to Senior Physician.

Profile

Profile
• Specialist title in General Internal Medicine (for foreign degrees, MEBEKO recognition required).

• Experience in sonography is desirable; opportunity to acquire and deepen ultrasound skills with certified tutors available.

• Preference for the challenge of working independently in the familiar environment of a smaller hospital.

• Team player with enthusiasm for interdisciplinary collaboration.

• Enjoyment in fostering assistant doctors and high willingness to innovate and commitment to the development of our internal medicine department.

Contact

For questions about the position (reference 2979):
Dr. med. T. Hoffmann
Deputy Head of Medicine
Tel: +41 (0)61 704 43 57

The Dornach Hospital (DO) guarantees extended basic medical care in the northern part of the canton. More than 350 employees ensure round-the-clock medical care and the well-being of patients.
The cooperation with the Crossklinik and various other collaborations with affiliated and consulting physicians from the region complete the offer.
requirements: Specialist title in General Internal Medicine with MEBEKO recognition for foreign degrees
Experience in sonography is desirable
Preference for independent work in a smaller hospital environment
Team player with interdisciplinary collaboration skills
Enthusiasm for training assistant doctors
Willingness to innovate and develop the department
Flexible working options, including job sharing
Interest in advancement to Senior Physician role

fr.title: Médecin Cadre Médecine (h/f/d)

Tâches

• Prise en charge des patientes et patients hospitalisés dans le service d'hospitalisation et l'IMC, ainsi que des patientes et patients ambulatoires dans notre service d'urgence animé.

• Soutien actif à la formation et au perfectionnement de nos médecins assistants motivés.

• Collaboration collégiale et étroite avec d'autres départements spécialisés et médecins référents.

• Flexibilité maximale : possibilité de partage de poste, jours de travail fixes possibles sur demande.

Profil

Profil
• Titre de spécialiste en Médecine Interne Générale (pour les diplômes étrangers, reconnaissance MEBEKO requise).

• Expérience en échographie souhaitée ; possibilité d'acquérir et de perfectionner des compétences en échographie avec des tuteurs certifiés.

Contact

Pour toute question concernant le poste (référence 2979) :
Dr. med. T. Hoffmann
Médecin adjoint Médecine
Tél : +41 (0)61 704 43 57

La coopération avec la Crossklinik et diverses autres collaborations avec des médecins agréés et consultants de la région complètent l'offre.

Expérience en échographie souhaitée
Préférence pour un travail autonome dans un petit hôpital

Intérêt pour une évolution vers un poste de Médecin Chef

de.title: Pflegefachfrau / Pflegefachmann HF in Ausbildung, verkürzt, 2 Jahre (w/m/d)

• Übernehmen von administrativen Aufgaben wie Beobachtungen und Pflegemassnahmen dokumentieren

Profil

Profil

• Kommunikative, begeisterungsfähige Persönlichkeit, die gerne Verantwortung übernimmt

Kontakt

Bei Fragen zur Stelle (Referenz 3263):
Frau A. Gygax
Berufsbildungsverantwortliche HF/FH soH
Tel: +41 (0)32 627 46 98

Das Kantonsspital Olten (KSO) garantiert die erweiterte medizinische Grundversorgung der Region Olten-Gösgen und Thal-Gäu. Rund 1'300 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter sorgen rund um die Uhr für die medizinische Betreuung und das Wohlergehen der Patientinnen und Patienten. Ergänzend zur Grundversorgung besitzt das KSO die Schwerpunktangebote Akutgeriatrie, Wirbelsäulenchirurgie und Urologie.

it.title: Infermiere/a diplomato/a HF in formazione abbreviata, 2 anni (m/f/d)
it.description:
Compiti

• Cura e assistenza di pazienti con diverse patologie e limitazioni fisiche

• Svolgimento di compiti amministrativi come documentare osservazioni e misure di cura

• Lavoro di squadra intra e interprofessionale

• Svolgimento di attività di consulenza, coordinamento e supporto nella quotidianità assistenziale

• Esecuzione di compiti tecnico-medici e reazione a situazioni impreviste nella quotidianità assistenziale

Profilo

• Operatore/trice sociosanitario/a con attestato federale di capacità (AFC)

• Personalità comunicativa ed entusiasta, che ama assumersi responsabilità

## Descrizione  
For our client in Basel, we are looking for an experienced Platform & Power BI Analyst.  

## Mansioni  
- Develop, optimize, and maintain Power BI reports and interactive dashboards  
- Analyze business requirements and translate them into sustainable BI solutions  
- Model, prepare, and transform data from various data sources  
- Ensure data quality and continuously optimize existing data models  
- Manage and further develop the Power BI platform, including governance and permission concepts  
- Support business departments in data-driven decision-making through meaningful analyses  
- Optimize the performance of reports, datasets, and dataflows  
- Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, IT, and international teams  
- Document BI solutions and provide support to end users  

## Requisiti  
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Data Analytics, or a comparable qualification  
- Several years of experience in Business Intelligence or Data Analytics  
- Strong expertise in Microsoft Power BI (Desktop & Service), including DAX, Power Query, and data modeling  
- Proficiency in SQL and working with relational databases  
- Strong knowledge of Power Apps (Canvas Apps), Power Automate, and SharePoint  
- Proven ability in requirements gathering and business analysis  
- Good understanding of ETL processes and Data Warehousing  
- Ideally, familiarity with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, or other cloud platforms  
- Experience in an international corporate environment; experience in logistics or supply chain is an advantage  
- Understanding of Data Governance and BI best practices is an advantage  
- Familiarity with Microsoft Dataverse and API integrations is a plus  
- Analytical, structured, and independent working style  
- Fluent English; German and/or French are an advantage

en.title: Machine Operator 80 - 100% (m/f/d)
en.description:
Description
As a Machine Operator (m/f/d), you will be a valuable member of our production team and contribute directly to the quality of our products through your technical understanding and meticulous work approach. Together with your team, you will ensure that production runs smoothly and that our high standards in terms of safety, quality, and efficiency are consistently met.

Responsibilities
- Casting of bushings as well as molding and demolding of winding bodies
- Operating and monitoring the resin casting system, including preparation and post-processing
- Documenting production and process values
- Troubleshooting minor issues and assisting with maintenance and repair work
- Performing quality checks on manufactured products
- Complying with all safety, quality, and environmental regulations
- Actively contributing to the improvement of processes and workflows

Requirements
- Strong safety and quality awareness
- Basic technical understanding and interest in production processes
- Completed technical training or further education (e.g., plant operator) is an advantage
- Willingness to work in a 3-shift operation
- Good knowledge of German (at least B1 level)
- Experience with pallet trucks, cranes, or lifting platforms is an advantage

What we offer
- Secure job in a future-oriented company
- Varied tasks with development opportunities
- A collegial working environment with open communication
- Attractive social benefits and modern working conditions

- Agire come ponte centrale tra il dipartimento e lo sviluppo, con una solida comprensione dei sistemi di Enterprise Resource Planning e dei sistemi di E-Commerce, nonché della loro integrazione e supporto.

- Gestire gli stakeholder nell'ambito delle vendite: bilanciare gli interessi diversi di vendite, marketing, servizio clienti e management, creare basi per le decisioni e portare a soluzioni sostenibili.

- Esperienza pluriennale come IT Business Analyst nei processi di vendita, ordine, consegna e/o reso.

- Buona comprensione di SAP.

- Entusiasmare i clienti per le tendenze e le novità e consigliare in modo individuale e appropriato è esattamente ciò che ti riesce meglio – ed è il tuo compito quotidiano.

- Con motivazione, contribuisci a mantenere il negozio sempre in ordine.

- Gestisci con grande attenzione le merci nel nostro punto vendita.

- La responsabilità della cassa è anche tua.

Requisiti

- Preferisci lavorare con le persone. Il team e i clienti percepiscono la tua passione giorno dopo giorno.

- Affabile, impegnato e attento: queste tre caratteristiche ti descrivono meglio.

- Hai completato una formazione professionale e/o hai esperienza preferibilmente come venditore di profumi, estetista o farmacista? Cerchiamo persone come te.

- Il tedesco lo parli e lo scrivi bene. E se parli lingue straniere, tanto meglio.

- È per te scontato essere flessibile negli orari di lavoro (da lunedì a sabato) nel settore delle vendite.

- Ti importa di come ti presenti. Crei la combinazione perfetta tra eleganza e naturalezza.

- Sorridere sempre: questo è il tuo segreto per il successo.

Cosa offriamo

- Vantaggi: sconto sull'offerta di viaggio ITS Coop Travel, 5 volte il numero di Superpunti nel supermercato, fino al 20% di sconto su vari servizi assicurativi, fino al 20% di sconto in tutti i formati del gruppo Coop, abbonamenti mobili e prepagati a prezzi ridotti con Coop Mobile, Reka-Card: sconto all'acquisto, sconto su Mobility CarSharing, sconto per il personale anche per il partner (che vive nello stesso nucleo familiare).

- Condizioni di assunzione: cassa pensione: 2/3 versato da Coop, contratto collettivo di lavoro (GAV), 18 settimane di congedo di maternità retribuito e 4 settimane di congedo di paternità retribuito, premi di fedeltà, piano di risparmio presso la cassa pensione, regolamento flessibile e attraente per una pensione anticipata a partire dal compimento del 58° anno di età, condizioni di assunzione attraenti.

- Orario di lavoro: 5 settimane di ferie.

- Formazione: oltre 600 corsi di formazione interna, supporto per corsi di formazione esterni, gestione dei talenti con molteplici opportunità di sviluppo.

- Salute: Update-Fitness: Fr. 200.– di sconto sull'abbonamento annuale.

Il tuo referente
Pamela Padovano
HR Marketing

en.title: Sales Consultant
en.description:
Tasks

- Exciting customers about trends and new products and advising them individually and appropriately is exactly your thing – and your daily task.

- Motivated, you help ensure that the store always looks well-maintained.

- You manage the goods on our sales floor very diligently.

- You are also responsible for the cash register.

Requirements

- You prefer working with people. The team and customers feel your passion day after day.

- Winning, engaged, and attentive: these three qualities describe you best.

- Completed vocational training and/or experience preferably as a perfume salesperson, cosmetologist, or druggist? We are looking for people like you.

- You have a good command of German – both spoken and written. And if you can speak foreign languages, even better.

- Being flexible with working hours (Mon to Sat) in sales is a given for you.

- How you present yourself is important to you. You create the perfect combination of elegance and naturalness.

- Always smile: that is your secret to success.

What we offer

- Benefits: Discount on the travel offer ITS Coop Travel, 5 times the number of Superpoints in the supermarket, up to 20% discount on various insurance services, up to 20% discount in all formats of the Coop Group, cheaper mobile and prepaid subscriptions with Coop Mobile, Reka-Card: discount on purchase, discount on Mobility CarSharing, employee discount also for partner (living in the same household).

- Employment conditions: Pension fund: 2/3 paid by Coop, collective labor agreement (GAV), 18 weeks of paid maternity leave and 4 weeks of paid paternity leave, loyalty bonuses, savings plan with the pension fund, flexible and attractive arrangement for early retirement from the age of 58, attractive employment conditions.

- Working hours: 5 weeks of vacation.

- Further education: Over 600 internal training courses, support for external training and further education, talent management with diverse development opportunities.

- Health: Update-Fitness: Fr. 200.– discount on the annual subscription.

Your contact person
Pamela Padovano
HR Marketing
requirements: You prefer working with people.
Winning, engaged, and attentive.
Completed vocational training and/or experience as a perfume salesperson, cosmetologist, or druggist.
Good command of German – spoken and written.
Flexibility with working hours (Mon to Sat).
Importance of personal appearance.
Always smile.

fr.title: Conseiller de Vente
fr.description:
Tâches

- Enthousiasmer les clients pour les tendances et les nouveautés et les conseiller de manière individuelle et appropriée est exactement ce que vous faites le mieux – et c'est votre tâche quotidienne.

- Motivé, vous contribuez à ce que le magasin ait toujours l'air bien entretenu.

- Vous gérez les marchandises sur notre surface de vente avec beaucoup de diligence.

- Vous êtes également responsable de la caisse.

Exigences

- Vous préférez travailler avec des gens. L'équipe et les clients ressentent votre passion jour après jour.

- Gagnant, engagé et attentif : ces trois qualités vous décrivent le mieux.

- Formation professionnelle terminée et/ou expérience de préférence en tant que vendeur de parfums, esthéticien ou droguiste ? Nous recherchons des personnes comme vous.

- Vous maîtrisez l'allemand – à l'oral et à l'écrit. Et si vous parlez des langues étrangères, c'est encore mieux.

- Être flexible avec les horaires de travail (du lundi au samedi) dans la vente est pour vous une évidence.

- L'apparence est importante pour vous. Vous créez la combinaison parfaite entre élégance et naturel.

- Sourire toujours : c'est votre secret du succès.

Ce que nous offrons

- Avantages : réduction sur l'offre de voyage ITS Coop Travel, 5 fois le nombre de Superpoints dans le supermarché, jusqu'à 20 % de réduction sur divers services d'assurance, jusqu'à 20 % de réduction dans tous les formats du groupe Coop, abonnements mobiles et prépayés à prix réduits avec Coop Mobile, Reka-Card : réduction à l'achat, réduction sur Mobility CarSharing, réduction pour le personnel également pour le partenaire (vivant dans le même ménage).

- Conditions d'emploi : caisse de pension : 2/3 payé par Coop, convention collective de travail (GAV), 18 semaines de congé maternité payé et 4 semaines de congé paternité payé, primes de fidélité, plan d'épargne auprès de la caisse de pension, règlement flexible et attrayant pour une retraite anticipée à partir de 58 ans, conditions d'emploi attrayantes.

- Horaires de travail : 5 semaines de vacances.

- Formation : plus de 600 cours de formation internes, soutien pour les formations externes, gestion des talents avec de nombreuses possibilités de développement.

- Santé : Update-Fitness : Fr. 200.– de réduction sur l'abonnement annuel.

Votre personne de contact
Pamela Padovano
HR Marketing

Formation professionnelle terminée et/ou expérience en tant que vendeur de parfums, esthéticien ou droguiste.

Importance de l'apparence personnelle.
Sourire toujours.

de.title: Verkaufsberater:in
de.description:
Aufgaben

- Die Kundschaft für Trends und Neuheiten zu begeistern und sie individuell und typgerecht zu beraten, ist genau dein Ding – und deine tägliche Aufgabe.

- Motiviert hilfst du mit, dass der Laden immer gepflegt aussieht.

- Die Bewirtschaftung der Waren auf unserer Verkaufsfläche übernimmst du sehr gewissenhaft.

- Die Verantwortung für das Kassawesen liegt ebenfalls bei dir.

Anforderungen

- Am liebsten arbeitest du mit Menschen. Team und Kundschaft spüren deine Leidenschaft Tag für Tag.

- Gewinnend, engagiert und aufmerksam: Diese drei Eigenschaften beschreiben dich am besten.

- Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung und/oder Erfahrung vorzugsweise als Parfümverkäufer:in, Kosmetiker:in oder Drogist:in? Leute wie dich suchen wir.

- Deutsch hast du im Griff – mündlich und schriftlich. Und wenn du Fremdsprachen kannst, umso besser.

- Dass man im Verkauf bei den Einsatzzeiten (Mo. bis Sa.) flexibel sein sollte, ist für dich selbstverständlich.

- Vergünstigungen: Rabatt auf das Reiseangebot ITS Coop Travel, 5-fache Anzahl Superpunkte im Supermarkt, bis zu 20% Rabatt auf verschiedene Versicherungsleistungen, bis zu 20% Rabatt in allen Formaten der Coop-Gruppe, günstigere Mobile- und Prepaid-Abos bei Coop Mobile, Personalrabatt auch für Partner:in (im gleichen Haushalt lebend)

- Anstellungsbedingungen: Pensionskasse: 2/3 wird von Coop einbezahlt, Gesamtarbeitsvertrag (GAV), 18 Wochen bezahlter Mutterschaftsurlaub und 4 Wochen bezahlter Vaterschaftsurlaub, Treueprämien, Sparplan bei der Pensionskasse, Flexible und attraktive Regelung für eine vorzeitige Alterspension ab dem vollendeten 58. Altersjahr

- Arbeitszeit: 5 Wochen Ferien

- Weiterbildung: Über 600 interne Weiterbildungskurse, Unterstützung für externe Aus- und Weiterbildungen, Talentmanagement mit vielfältigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

- Gesundheit: Update-Fitness: Fr. 200.– Rabatt aufs Jahresabonnement

Deine Ansprechperson
Suzana Jovanovic
HR Marketing
requirements: Deutsch hast du im Griff – mündlich und schriftlich.

La Swissquote Chair in Quantitative Finance à l'EPFL recherche des postdocs pour renforcer nos recherches en finance quantitative avec un accent sur l'apprentissage automatique appliqué.

Tâches
- Travailler et collaborer sur des projets de recherche. Les sujets de recherche précis seront discutés avec le candidat retenu en fonction de son parcours, de ses compétences et de ses affinités.
- Analyse et publication des résultats
- Construire un réseau solide dans le domaine de la recherche
- Participer à l'enseignement et à la supervision des doctorants et des étudiants en master

Ce que nous offrons
- Un environnement de travail stimulant et international
- Un salaire compétitif et d'excellentes conditions de travail – plus d'informations sont disponibles sur notre site web (https://www.epfl.ch/campus/services/human-resources/en/basic-starting-salary-of-doctoral-assistants-and-postdocs/)
- Opportunité de mener des recherches de pointe dans l'une des institutions scientifiques les plus dynamiques d'Europe.
- Opportunité d'interagir avec des experts de renommée internationale et avec une équipe solide de chercheurs postdoctoraux et d'étudiants en doctorat

Informations
Seules les candidatures soumises via la plateforme en ligne seront prises en compte. Vous êtes invité à fournir :
- Une brève lettre de motivation (pdf, jusqu'à 2 pages).

de.title: E-Shop Manager
de.description:
Aufgaben

- Du verantwortest als Product Owner die Weiterentwicklung und Umsetzung unserer E-Commerce-Umgebung.

- Du analysierst das Kundenverhalten entlang der Customer Journey und leitest Massnahmen zur Steigerung von Conversion, Umsatz und Kundenzufriedenheit ab.

- Du priorisierst Anforderungen aus Business, Marketing, CRM, Retail und IT und stellst die Balance zwischen Kundennutzen, Business Value und technischer Machbarkeit sicher.

- Du übersetzt fachliche und betriebswirtschaftliche Anforderungen in User Stories und Jira-Tickets und begleitest diese im Scrum-Prozess von der Spezifikation über Testing bis zum Go-Live.

- Gemeinsam mit dem Team von impo.ch gestaltest du die Weiterentwicklung unseres E-Commerce aktiv mit und bringst eigene Ideen ein.

- Du beobachtest Trends und neue Technologien im digitalen Handel und bringst innovative Impulse ein.

Anforderungen

- Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im E-Commerce mit und hast Freude daran, das Wachstum von impo.ch aktiv mitzugestalten.

- Erfahrung mit GA4, Web Analytics oder BI-Tools ist von Vorteil.

- Du verfügst über stilsicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift; gute Englisch- und Französischkenntnisse sind ein Plus.

- Die Herausforderungen eines Omnichannel-Unternehmens meisterst du mit Agilität, Eigeninitiative und Freude.

- Du packst zukünftige Projekte motiviert an und setzt diese gemeinsam mit dem Team erfolgreich um.

- Du bist eine zuverlässige und kommunikative Persönlichkeit mit Teamgeist und gehst sicher mit gängigen Office- und Kollaborationstools um.

Was wir bieten

- Vergünstigungen: Rabatt auf das Reiseangebot ITS Coop Travel, 5-fache Anzahl Superpunkte im Supermarkt, bis zu 20% Rabatt auf verschiedene Versicherungsleistungen, bis zu 20% Rabatt in allen Formaten der Coop-Gruppe, günstigere Mobile- und Prepaid-Abos bei Coop Mobile, Reka-Card: Vergünstigung bei Bezug, Personalrabatt auch für Partner:in (im gleichen Haushalt lebend), Vergünstigung bei GA-Abonnement

- Anstellungsbedingungen: Pensionskasse: 2/3 wird von Coop einbezahlt, Gesamtarbeitsvertrag (GAV), 18 Wochen bezahlter Mutterschaftsurlaub und 4 Wochen bezahlter Vaterschaftsurlaub, Treueprämien, Sparplan bei der Pensionskasse, Home-Office, Flexible und attraktive Regelung für eine vorzeitige Alterspension ab dem vollendeten 58. Altersjahr, attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen

- Arbeitszeit: 5 Wochen Ferien

- Weiterbildung: Über 600 interne Weiterbildungskurse, Unterstützung für externe Aus- und Weiterbildungen, Talentmanagement mit vielfältigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Una componente centrale del nostro lavoro è lo sviluppo e la fornitura di un ecosistema di strumenti performante, che consenta di rilevare e gestire in modo efficiente e professionale gli attacchi informatici. Questo ecosistema viene continuamente sviluppato e integrato con le tecnologie più moderne.

Mansioni
- Con i tuoi impulsi innovativi, affini i nostri sistemi di rilevamento e risposta di alto livello e garantisci che siamo sempre un passo avanti rispetto agli scenari di attacco più avanzati
- Collaborazione con il team di Cyber Defense, con l'obiettivo di aumentare in modo sostenibile la maturità della sicurezza e l'automazione delle risposte
- La tua missione: trasformare processi di sicurezza complessi in flussi di lavoro intelligenti e automatizzati
- Porta impulsi innovativi nel nostro ecosistema di strumenti già ben consolidato e contribuisci alle prestazioni di punta dell'intero CDC

Requisiti
- Solida esperienza professionale: nel campo del Cyber Defense Engineering
- Laurea completata (Uni/ETH, FH, HF): con specializzazione nel settore della sicurezza informatica
- Ottima conoscenza di Python ed esperienza con TDD, Design Patterns e Code Reviews. Esperienza nello sviluppo con Go è un vantaggio
- Forte esperienza con CI/CD (GitLab) e con metodi di lavoro agili come DevSecOps o Scrum (Atlassian)
- Solida comprensione dei principi di Infrastructure-as-Code per la configurazione dichiarativa e la distribuzione di applicazioni moderne
- Metodo di lavoro strategico e lungimirante e personalità affidabile e autonoma
- Entusiasmo nell'implementazione delle proprie idee e piacere nel lavoro di squadra
- Formazione continua e certificazioni come CAS/MAS, CISSP, OSCP o CE
- Tedesco (livello negoziale)
- Inglese (buona conoscenza)

Cosa offriamo
- Modello di lavoro flessibile: flessibilità temporale e spaziale nell'adempimento della funzione (indicativamente 40% di lavoro da remoto)
- Sede centrale: Sede centrale nella città di Zurigo (Limmatplatz o vicino a Hardbrücke)
- Salari equi: Retribuzione orientata alla funzione e al mercato - certificata "We pay fair"
- Previdenza professionale: Prestazioni superiori alla media e tre diversi piani di risparmio adatti alla situazione individuale
- Spazio per la progettazione e le decisioni: Possibilità di plasmare e sviluppare autonomamente il campo di attività
- Migros Bank: Conto gratuito e tassi di interesse preferenziali sul conto corrente e di risparmio

Contatto
Candidatura & Contatto
Yanick Mohn
Talent Acquisition Partner - LinkedIn

Processo di selezione
Invio della candidatura
Per una candidatura completa abbiamo bisogno del tuo CV, dei tuoi certificati e diplomi. Una foto nel CV e una lettera motivazionale non sono necessari. Promuoviamo la parità di opportunità per tutti i candidati. Abbiamo un processo di selezione standardizzato. Se ciò non fosse possibile per te, menzionalo nel tuo dossier di candidatura.

Preselezione delle candidature
Esaminiamo continuamente le candidature ricevute, effettuiamo una preselezione e la sottoponiamo al responsabile per la revisione. La decisione di procedere o meno nel processo di selezione sarà comunicata telefonicamente o via e-mail. Tempo di risposta: fino a tre settimane.

Colloquio con HR & reparto tecnico
Il colloquio viene condotto con il responsabile delle risorse umane e/o con il reparto tecnico, in modalità virtuale o in presenza. L'obiettivo principale è conoscere meglio le competenze personali e tecniche e consentire a entrambe le parti di valutare l'idoneità culturale all'azienda e al team. Tempo di risposta: fino a tre settimane.

Colloquio tecnico con presentazione di un caso
Le competenze tecniche specifiche vengono valutate attraverso un caso pratico o altri strumenti di valutazione. Dopo l'elaborazione, il risultato viene presentato al responsabile e successivamente discusso insieme. Di solito, i colloqui sono condotti dal responsabile diretto, senza rappresentanti delle risorse umane. Tempo di risposta: fino a tre settimane.

Conoscenza del team
Se una persona si adatta al team è un fattore importante sia per i dipendenti che per i datori di lavoro nella decisione di assunzione. In un contesto informale, offriamo quindi l'opportunità di conoscersi reciprocamente.

Offerta & Contratto (digitale)
Dopo la nostra offerta orale, i punti principali del contratto vengono nuovamente verificati. Dopo l'accordo, viene avviata la creazione del contratto e inviato per la firma digitale via e-mail. Tempo di risposta: fino a una settimana.

en.title: Senior Cyber Defense Engineer (w/m/d)
en.description:
The Cyber Defense Center (CDC) protects the companies of the Migros Group from cyberattacks. A central component of our work is the development and provision of a powerful tool ecosystem that enables efficient and professional detection and processing of cyberattacks. This ecosystem is continuously developed and complemented with the latest technologies.

Responsibilities
- With your innovative impulses, you refine our high-end detection and response systems and ensure that we are always one step ahead of advanced attack scenarios
- Collaborate with the Cyber Defense team to sustainably increase security maturity and response automation
- Your mission: Transform complex security processes into smart, automated workflows
- Bring innovative ideas to our already well-established tool ecosystem and shape the top performance of the entire CDC

Requirements
- Solid professional experience: in the field of Cyber Defense Engineering
- Completed degree (Uni/ETH, FH, HF): with a specialization in information security
- Excellent Python skills and experience with TDD, design patterns, and code reviews. Experience in development with Go is an advantage
- Strong CI/CD experience (GitLab), as well as with agile working methods such as DevSecOps or Scrum (Atlassian)
- Solid understanding of Infrastructure-as-Code principles for declarative configuration and deployment of modern applications
- Strategic, forward-thinking work methodology and resilient, self-reliant personality
- Enthusiasm for implementing your own ideas and enjoyment of teamwork
- Further education and certifications such as CAS/MAS, CISSP, OSCP, or CE
- German (business fluent)
- English (good knowledge)

What we offer
- Mobile-flexible working model: Temporal and spatial flexibility in fulfilling the role (approximately 40% home office)
- Central workplace: Central workplace in the city of Zurich (Limmatplatz or near Hardbrücke)
- Fair wages: Function-oriented and market-competitive remuneration - "We pay fair" certified
- Occupational pension: Above-average benefits and three different savings plans tailored to individual life situations
- Room for creativity and decision-making: Opportunity to independently shape and develop the scope of tasks
- Migros Bank: Free account management and preferential interest rates on private and savings accounts

Contact
Application & Contact
Yanick Mohn
Talent Acquisition Partner - LinkedIn

Recruitment process
Submit application
For a complete application, we need your CV, certificates, and diplomas. A photo in the CV and a cover letter are not necessary. We promote equal opportunities for all applicants. We have a standardized recruitment process. If this does not work for you, please mention it in your application documents.

Pre-selection of applications
We continuously review incoming applications, create a pre-selection, and release it to the manager for review. The decision to proceed or not in the recruitment process will be communicated via phone or email. Response time: Up to three weeks.

Interview with HR & department
The interview will be conducted with the responsible person from HR and/or the department, either virtually or on-site. The primary goal is to learn more about personal and professional competencies and to allow both parties to assess cultural fit within the company and team. Response time: Up to three weeks.

Technical interview with case presentation
Specific technical knowledge will be assessed using a case or other assessment tools. After processing, the result will be presented to the manager and then discussed together. Usually, the interviews are conducted by the direct supervisor without an HR representative. Response time: Up to three weeks.

Team introduction
Whether someone fits into the team is an important factor for both employees and employers in deciding on employment. Therefore, we offer the opportunity for everyone to get to know each other in an informal setting.

Offer & contract issuance (digital)
After our verbal job offer, the main contract points will be verified again. After agreement, the contract creation will be initiated and sent for digital signature via email. Response time: Up to one week.

fr.title: Ingénieur Senior en Défense Cybernétique (h/f/d)
fr.description:
Le Cyber Defense Center (CDC) protège les sociétés du groupe Migros contre les cyberattaques. Un élément central de notre travail est le développement et la mise à disposition d'un écosystème d'outils performant, permettant une détection et un traitement efficaces et professionnels des cyberattaques. Cet écosystème est continuellement développé et complété par les technologies les plus modernes.

Responsabilités
- Avec vos impulsions innovantes, vous affinez nos systèmes de détection et de réponse haut de gamme et veillez à ce que nous soyons toujours un pas en avant sur les scénarios d'attaques avancés
- Collaborer avec l'équipe de défense cybernétique pour augmenter durablement la maturité de la sécurité et l'automatisation des réponses
- Votre mission : Transformer des processus de sécurité complexes en workflows intelligents et automatisés
- Apporter des idées innovantes à notre écosystème d'outils déjà bien établi et façonner les performances de pointe de l'ensemble du CDC

Exigences
- Solide expérience professionnelle : dans le domaine de l'ingénierie de défense cybernétique
- Diplôme universitaire (Uni/ETH, FH, HF) : avec une spécialisation en sécurité de l'information
- Excellentes compétences en Python et expérience avec TDD, les design patterns et les revues de code. Une expérience en développement avec Go est un atout
- Solide expérience en CI/CD (GitLab), ainsi qu'avec des méthodes de travail agiles telles que DevSecOps ou Scrum (Atlassian)
- Bonne compréhension des principes d'Infrastructure-as-Code pour la configuration déclarative et le déploiement d'applications modernes
- Méthodologie de travail stratégique et prévoyante, personnalité résiliente et autonome
- Enthousiasme pour la mise en œuvre de vos propres idées et plaisir à travailler en équipe
- Formations continues et certifications telles que CAS/MAS, CISSP, OSCP ou CE
- Allemand (niveau négociation)
- Anglais (bon niveau)

Ce que nous offrons
- Modèle de travail flexible et mobile : Flexibilité temporelle et spatiale dans l'exercice de la fonction (environ 40% de télétravail)
- Lieu de travail central : Lieu de travail central dans la ville de Zurich (Limmatplatz ou près de Hardbrücke)
- Salaires équitables : Rémunération fonctionnelle et compétitive sur le marché - certifiée "We pay fair"
- Prévoyance professionnelle : Prestations supérieures à la moyenne et trois plans d'épargne différents adaptés à la situation individuelle
- Liberté de création et de décision : Possibilité de façonner et de développer de manière autonome le champ d'activité
- Banque Migros : Gestion de compte gratuite et taux d'intérêt préférentiels sur les comptes privés et d'épargne

Processus de recrutement
Soumission de la candidature
Pour une candidature complète, nous avons besoin de votre CV, de vos certificats et diplômes. Une photo dans le CV et une lettre de motivation ne sont pas nécessaires. Nous promouvons l'égalité des chances pour tous les candidats. Nous avons un processus de recrutement standardisé. Si cela ne fonctionne pas pour vous, veuillez le mentionner dans votre dossier de candidature.

Pré-sélection des candidatures
Nous examinons en continu les candidatures reçues, effectuons une pré-sélection et la soumettons au responsable pour examen. La décision de poursuivre ou non dans le processus de recrutement sera communiquée par téléphone ou par e-mail. Délai de réponse : Jusqu'à trois semaines.

Entretien avec les RH & le département
L'entretien sera mené avec la personne responsable des RH et/ou du département, soit virtuellement, soit sur place. L'objectif principal est d'en savoir plus sur les compétences personnelles et professionnelles et de permettre aux deux parties d'évaluer l'adéquation culturelle avec l'entreprise et l'équipe. Délai de réponse : Jusqu'à trois semaines.

en.title: Climate Program Manager, Sustainability & Economic Policy Directorate
en.description:
Our directorate is responsible for managing and implementing sustainability, economic policy issues, and customer service for the Migros Group. As maternity cover, you will take on the role of Climate Program Manager, steering and coordinating the climate strategy (all climate-related sustainability goals) across the entire group, including value chains and products.

Responsibilities
- Steering, coordinating, and further developing the Climate Program, which includes implementing the climate strategy across the entire Migros Group
- Active internal and external stakeholder management for the Climate Program
- Developing and communicating decision-making bases and concepts for the Climate Program
- Independently managing cross-departmental and cross-company projects
- Participating in steering committees on climate-related topics

Requirements
- Solid professional experience: in project management and sustainability in a business context (experience in corporate consulting and transformations is an advantage)
- Completed studies (Uni/ETH, FH, HF): in project management and sustainability in a business context (experience in corporate consulting and transformations is an advantage)
- German (fluent) English (fluent): French and Italian are an advantage
- Interdisciplinary thinking with strong result orientation and prioritization (achieving sustainable and measurable results)
- In-depth knowledge of climate topics, ideally with reference to the food and retail industries
- Strong analytical and conceptual skills in project management and sustainability

- Gestion autonome de projets transversaux et inter-entreprises
- Participation aux comités de pilotage sur les sujets climatiques

- Compétences analytiques et conceptuelles développées en gestion de projets et durabilité

Descrizione

Vuoi entrare a far parte del nostro team innovativo e motivato nella Pneumologia e diventare un membro fondamentale? Allora aspettiamo con piacere la tua candidatura come Assistente di Studio Medico (MPA) per la Clinica di Pneumologia, caratterizzata da un contenuto lavorativo vario e dinamico. Le tue principali mansioni includeranno l'assistenza in endoscopia e l'esecuzione di tutte le misurazioni funzionali polmonari e di medicina del sonno.

Mansioni

- Assistenza nella sala pleurica durante ecografie pleuriche, punture pleuriche, inserimenti di cateteri PleuX e broncoscopie

- La collaborazione apprezzata e amichevole all'interno dei team e tra i reparti caratterizza l'ambiente lavorativo al KSW. Come segno di un forte spirito di squadra, il "tu" è stato introdotto come standard al KSW. Inoltre, il KSW supporta finanziariamente eventi di team annuali e organizza ogni quattro anni una grande festa per tutto il personale.

- Con sconti su abbonamenti fitness, possibilità di allenamento interno e corsi, sconti in farmacie e presso le principali casse malati, puoi beneficiare di un'offerta completa per la tua salute.

en.title: Medical Practice Assistant
en.description:
Description

Would you like to become a member of our Pneumology team and play a vital role in our innovative and motivated team? Then we look forward to receiving your application as a Medical Practice Assistant (MPA) for the Clinic of Pneumology, which is characterized by its varied and dynamic work content. Your main tasks will include assisting in endoscopy and performing all pulmonary function and sleep medicine measurements.

Responsibilities

- Assisting in the pleura room during pleural ultrasounds, pleural punctures, PleuX catheter insertions, and bronchoscopies
- Independently performing PleuX controls, drainage insertions, and suture removals
- Organizing daily workflows (daily responsibility for the entire endoscopy unit with main phone)
- Performing pulmonary function tests (spirometry, body plethysmography, CO diffusion, respiratory muscle strength measurement PImax, Sniff), measuring exhaled NO, venous/capillary/arterial blood sampling, assisting and preparing spiroergometry
- Sleep diagnostics (oximetry, polygraphy), managing the semi-stationary sleep lab
- Billing for all performed services

Requirements

- You have completed training as an MPA and ideally have experience in pneumological endoscopy, pulmonary function, and/or sleep diagnostics
- You value independent work and have a quick grasp of new concepts
- You are a resilient individual with empathy and personal initiative
- You think in a networked and process-oriented manner and work in an organized and goal-oriented way
- You have a confident command of the German language, both written and spoken; good foreign language skills are also an advantage
- Your strong social skills, high flexibility, and commitment complete your profile

What We Offer

- KSW offers conditions that enable employees to align their professional goals with personal needs. Flexible, sliding working hours, home office options, generous maternity leave, and employment levels adapted to various life situations are all possible at KSW, provided operational needs allow.
- Each year, KSW offers 40 interdisciplinary and 50 specialized training courses. We also support external training in terms of time and/or finances.
- In extraordinary situations, such as prolonged illness, significant personal challenges, or difficult experiences in private or professional life, various counseling services are available.
- Appreciative and friendly collaboration within teams and across departments characterizes the working atmosphere at KSW. As a sign of strong team spirit, the "you" form of address has been introduced as standard at KSW. Additionally, KSW financially supports annual team events and organizes a large staff festival for the entire institution every four years.
- KSW employees benefit from excellent social benefits. The pension plan with BVK is far above the legal minimum. Employees are also well insured in case of illness or accident.
- With discounts on fitness subscriptions, internal training opportunities and courses, discounts at pharmacies, and with the most popular health insurers, you can benefit from a comprehensive health offering.
- Our daycare center La Luna, with generous opening hours, is located directly next to KSW. You can also take advantage of KSW's income-based financial support for daycare costs.
- In collaboration with cultural partners in and around Winterthur, we regularly offer discounts for concerts and theater performances. Borrowing media from the in-house library is also free for employees.

- Department: Clinic for Pneumology
- Workload: 80%

Souhaitez-vous rejoindre notre équipe de pneumologie et devenir un membre essentiel de notre équipe innovante et motivée ? Vos principales tâches incluront l'assistance en endoscopie et la réalisation de toutes les mesures fonctionnelles pulmonaires et de médecine du sommeil.

Responsabilités

- Assistance en salle pleurale lors d'échographies pleurales, ponctions pleurales, insertions de cathéters PleuX et bronchoscopies
- Réalisation autonome de contrôles PleuX, insertions de drains et retrait de sutures
- Organisation des flux de travail quotidiens (responsabilité quotidienne pour l'ensemble de l'endoscopie avec téléphone principal)
- Réalisation de tests de fonction pulmonaire (spirométrie, pléthysmographie corporelle, diffusion du CO, mesure de la force des muscles respiratoires PImax, Sniff), mesure du NO expiré, prélèvements sanguins veineux/capillaires/artériels, assistance et préparation pour la spiroergométrie
- Diagnostics du sommeil (oxymétrie, polygraphie), gestion du laboratoire du sommeil semi-stationnaire
- Facturation de toutes les prestations effectuées

Exigences

- Ausgewogenes Menü-Angebot in unserem Mitarbeiterrestaurant "Le Bistro" während der Wintersaison

- Bevorzugte Konditionen und Rabatte bei unseren Partnern (z.B.: Update Fitness, hauseigenes Sportgeschäft)

en.title: Food and Beverage Manager (m/w/d), permanent position
en.description:
Description
The Carlton Hotel in St. Moritz is a 5-star superior luxury hotel located at an altitude of 1,856 meters in the Grisons mountains, designed by Carlo Rampazzi. As one of the 4 properties of "The Tschuggen Collection AG," our hotel offers 60 individually designed suites and rooms, stylish restaurants – including the gourmet highlight Da Vittorio with 18 Gault Millau points & 2 Michelin stars and the Grand Restaurant, a homage to nature and the culinary delights of the Engadin – as well as an impressive 1,200 m² spa. We place great emphasis on sustainability, are Green Globe certified, and members of Leading Hotels of the World, Swiss Deluxe Hotels, Forbes Travel Guide, and American Express Fine Hotels & Resorts. OUR VISION - We give time its value back. Start date by agreement.

Requirements
- Completed professional training with further education in the Food and Beverage sector
- At least 2 years of professional experience in the same or comparable position in 4* or 5* hospitality
- Fluent German and English skills are required; additional languages, such as Italian, are advantageous
- Strong service orientation, high quality awareness, and attention to detail
- Well-groomed appearance, professional manners, and friendly demeanor
- Empathetic and discreet personality, as well as willingness to go the extra mile

Responsibilities
- Overall responsibility for the Food & Beverage area (Grand Restaurant, Da Vittorio - St. Moritz, Fondue Gondolas, Carlton Bar / Bel Etage and terrace, Room Service, purchasing, and events)
- Menu creation, cash and system management, and inventory control
- Planning and execution of exclusive events, banquets, and functions
- Leadership, motivation, and continuous development of employees according to LQA, Forbes, FHR, and internal QM standards
- Continuous analysis, optimization, and development of F&B concepts
- Preparation and evaluation of various statistics (e.g., profitability, monthly reporting, annual reporting)
- Taking on Duty Manager services

What we offer
- Balanced menu offerings in our employee restaurant "Le Bistro" during the winter season
- Yoga for employees, monthly pool evenings, and use of our fitness center during the winter season
- Preferred conditions and discounts with our partners (e.g., Update Fitness, in-house sports shop)
- Special rates for overnight stays at our "The Tschuggen Collection" properties and Swiss Deluxe Hotels
- Attractive external training opportunities

Contact
Feel addressed - Apply now! We look forward to receiving your application dossier - preferably digitally:
- Cover letter
- Complete resume including photo
- Work certificates & diplomas

Vuoi la libertà del lavoro temporaneo e la sicurezza di un impiego a tempo indeterminato? Da 30 anni affianchiamo centinaia di aziende nei settori tecnici dell’edilizia, delle costruzioni e dell’industria in tutta la Svizzera, proponendo loro i migliori talenti. Non ti mentiremo però: siamo esigenti. Quindi, se sei una persona motivata ed estremamente entusiasta, unisciti al nostro team per la posizione di Caposquadra – Montatore di condotte prefabbricate / Strutture metalliche

Il tuo incarico:
• Leggere e interpretare i disegni di montaggio.
• Montare e fissare tubazioni prefabbricate e strutture metalliche (soffitti e pareti).
• Assemblare, bullonare e regolare con precisione gli elementi meccanici.
• Lavorare in quota utilizzando piattaforme aeree.
• Controllare la qualità degli impianti (allineamento, fissaggi, conformità).
• Rispettare le norme di sicurezza e le procedure di cantiere.
• Individuare le anomalie tecniche e proporre soluzioni.
• Mantenere il cantiere pulito e organizzato.
• Coordinare una piccola squadra (da 2 a 3 persone) in base alla propria esperienza.

E ora parliamo di te?
• Oltre 5 anni di esperienza in cantiere o perfetta autonomia.
• Ottima capacità di lettura dei progetti e buone conoscenze di assemblaggio meccanico.
• A proprio agio nel lavoro in quota e in ambiente industriale.
• Patente svizzera per piattaforme aeree obbligatoria.
• Patente di guida indispensabile.
• Persona affidabile, rigorosa, autonoma e dotata di un buon spirito di squadra.
• Buona forma fisica e senso di responsabilità.

Il tuo referente:
Il tuo referente per questa posizione è Laetitia. Saprà accompagnarti, consigliarti e rispondere a tutte le tue domande relative alla posizione.
Questo lavoro non corrisponde esattamente a ciò che stai cercando, ma i nostri valori ti interessano? Non esitare a inviarci la tua candidatura spontanea!
Risponderemo solo alle candidature il cui profilo corrisponde alla descrizione richiesta.

en.title: Team Leader – Prefabricated Duct / Metal Structures Installer
en.description:
Do you want the freedom of temporary work and the security of a permanent position? For 30 years, we have been supporting hundreds of companies in the technical sectors of construction, building, and industry across Switzerland by providing them with the best talent. We won't lie to you though: we are demanding. So, if you are a motivated and highly enthusiastic person, join our team for the position of Team Leader – Prefabricated Duct / Metal Structures Installer.

Your responsibilities:
• Read and interpret assembly drawings.
• Install and secure prefabricated ducts and metal structures (ceilings and walls).
• Assemble, bolt, and precisely adjust mechanical elements.
• Work at heights using aerial platforms.
• Inspect the quality of installations (alignment, fastenings, compliance).
• Adhere to safety standards and site procedures.
• Identify technical anomalies and propose solutions.
• Maintain a clean and organized worksite.
• Coordinate a small team (2 to 3 people) based on your experience.

And now, let’s talk about you:
• Over 5 years of on-site experience or complete autonomy.
• Excellent ability to read blueprints and strong knowledge of mechanical assembly.
• Comfortable working at heights and in industrial environments.
• Swiss aerial platform license required.
• Driver's license essential.
• Reliable, rigorous, autonomous, and a good team player.
• Good physical condition and a strong sense of responsibility.

Your contact person:
Your contact person for this position is Laetitia. She will guide you, advise you, and answer all your questions about the position.

This job doesn’t exactly match what you’re looking for, but you’re interested in our values? Don’t hesitate to send us your spontaneous application!

We will only respond to applications whose profiles match the required description.
requirements: Over 5 years of on-site experience or complete autonomy
Excellent ability to read blueprints and strong knowledge of mechanical assembly
Comfortable working at heights and in industrial environments
Swiss aerial platform license required
Driver's license essential
Reliable, rigorous, autonomous, and a good team player
Good physical condition
Strong sense of responsibility

fr.title: Chef d'équipe – Monteur de conduits préfabriqués / Structures métalliques
fr.description:
Vous voulez la liberté du travail temporaire et la sécurité d’un emploi à durée indéterminée ? Depuis 30 ans, nous accompagnons des centaines d’entreprises dans les secteurs techniques de la construction, du bâtiment et de l’industrie dans toute la Suisse, en leur proposant les meilleurs talents. Nous ne vous mentirons pas : nous sommes exigeants. Alors, si vous êtes une personne motivée et extrêmement enthousiaste, rejoignez notre équipe pour le poste de Chef d'équipe – Monteur de conduits préfabriqués / Structures métalliques.

Vos missions :
• Lire et interpréter les plans de montage.
• Monter et fixer des conduits préfabriqués et des structures métalliques (plafonds et murs).
• Assembler, boulonner et ajuster avec précision les éléments mécaniques.
• Travailler en hauteur en utilisant des plateformes élévatrices.
• Contrôler la qualité des installations (alignement, fixations, conformité).
• Respecter les normes de sécurité et les procédures de chantier.
• Identifier les anomalies techniques et proposer des solutions.
• Maintenir le chantier propre et organisé.
• Coordonner une petite équipe (de 2 à 3 personnes) en fonction de votre expérience.

Et vous ?
• Plus de 5 ans d’expérience sur chantier ou parfaite autonomie.
• Excellente capacité de lecture des plans et bonnes connaissances en assemblage mécanique.
• À l’aise pour travailler en hauteur et en environnement industriel.
• Permis suisse pour plateformes élévatrices obligatoire.
• Permis de conduire indispensable.
• Personne fiable, rigoureuse, autonome et dotée d’un bon esprit d’équipe.
• Bonne condition physique et sens des responsabilités.

Votre contact :
Votre contact pour ce poste est Laetitia. Elle saura vous accompagner, vous conseiller et répondre à toutes vos questions relatives au poste.

it.description:

Non ti nascondiamo però che siamo esigenti. Quindi, se sei una persona motivata ed estremamente entusiasta, unisciti al nostro team per la posizione di Elettricista – Lavori di integrazione e impianti elettrici

Il tuo incarico:
• Eseguire i lavori di incasso di tubi e scatole elettriche in muri in calcestruzzo, solai e tramezzi (circa il 50% del capitolato d’appalto).
• Eseguire gli impianti elettrici standard: posa dei cavi, installazione degli apparecchi, collegamenti, preparazione delle linee e rifiniture.
• Leggere, comprendere e interpretare gli schemi elettrici e i disegni di incasso.
• Preparare, posare e fissare i condotti in conformità alle norme cantonali di Friburgo e alle direttive del cantiere.
• Garantire la qualità degli impianti integrati: allineamento, profondità, posizionamento, rispetto delle riserve e finiture impeccabili.
• Collaborare efficacemente con le altre figure professionali (muratori, carpentieri, tecnici della ventilazione, idraulici, ecc.) al fine di assicurare un coordinamento ottimale.
• Eseguire un lavoro pulito, preciso e conforme agli standard aziendali.
• Rappresentare Electrofil SA nei cantieri con professionalità, contribuendo al contempo a creare un clima di lavoro positivo.

E ora parliamo di te?
• Esperienza comprovata nei lavori di posa o negli impianti elettrici in cantiere.
• Ottima capacità di leggere e interpretare i progetti.
• A proprio agio con lavori su calcestruzzo, solai, muri in casseri e strutture grezze.
• Persona autonoma, affidabile, seria, rispettosa delle norme di sicurezza.
• Buona forma fisica e senso del lavoro ben fatto.
• Patente di guida indispensabile per gli spostamenti nei cantieri della Svizzera romanda.
• Capacità di integrarsi in un’azienda a conduzione familiare, con spirito di squadra, comunicazione semplice, atteggiamento costruttivo e buona padronanza del francese.
